observation.command:
echo "=== Keycloak client config ==="; docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh config credentials --server http://localhost:8080 --realm master --user admin --password admin >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh get clients -r my-realm 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(c['clientId'], c.get('publicClient'), c.get('redirectUris'), c.get('webOrigins'), c.get('standardFlowEnabled'), c.get('directAccessGrantsEnabled'), c.get('implicitFlowEnabled'), 'serviceAccounts='+str(c.get('serviceAccountsEnabled')), 'authz='+str(c.get('authorizationServicesEnabled'))) for c in d]"
echo "=== DB tables ==="; docker exec strassennamen-sql /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P 'Strassen!Passw0rd' -C -Q "SELECT name FROM Strassennamen.sys.tables ORDER BY name" 2>/dev/null | head -30
